status: PROVEN — first attempt revealed the pivot

actors.kevin: holds the body (Pixel), touches fingerprint to seal
actors.gaia_brain: triggers camera via ADB, decodes QR/visual data, processes

steps: 1. Target appears on ANY screen (QR, code, visual challenge)
2. Kevin holds Pixel, points back camera at target
3. Gaia fires shutter: adb shell 'input keyevent 27'
5. Gaia decodes (QR → pyzbar, text → OCR, visual → model)
6. Gaia acts on decoded data (enter code, submit form, register)
7. Kevin seals with fingerprint if approval needed

requirements.screen: MUST be local/physical — not through remote desktop layers
requirements.distance: Kevin + Pixel within arm's reach of target screen
requirements.camera: back camera 12.2MP, auto-focus, no flash needed for screens

failure_mode_discovered.fix: ensure target is on LOCAL screen or physical media

insight: This is NOT just QR scanning. This is shared proximity signing — the human holds the body, the organism sees through it, the fingerprint seals it. The three-way ceremony: HOLD → SEE → SEAL. A bingoCube coordination where Kevin's physical presence IS the authentication factor.
